settings.title: Settings
settings.showPaTagsHint: Show the <PAColor> tags of game text next to its colours
settings.handledOnlyHint: Limit the file tree and searches to files with a parsed table view
settings.checkAppUpdatesHint: Ask GitHub for a newer release when the app starts. Updating always takes a click.
settings.updateHandlersHint: Download new and fixed handlers from GitHub when the app starts. They are used after a restart.
settings.recordsCacheHint: Keep parsed tables on disk so they reopen without parsing again
settings.recordsCacheAll: Cache all tables in the background
settings.deleteCachesConfirm:
Delete the parsed table, icon and lookup index caches of this PAZ folder?

Tables parse again, icons decode again, and the next start builds the lookup indexes again. The PAZ index cache is kept.
settings.dataFolderHint: Where settings and caches are kept, with one cache folder per PAZ folder. Leave empty for the default.
settings.dataFolderConfirm:
Use the new data folder?

Your settings are copied there and replace any settings already in it. The caches in the old folder are deleted; the PAZ index of the loaded folder is saved again, and tables, icons and lookup indexes are built again when needed.
